name: Anterior Segment Developmental Anomaly with Extraocular Manifestations
aliases: Anterior Segment Dysgenesis with Systemic Features
Anterior Segment Developmental Disorder with Multisystem Involvement

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Anterior Segment Developmental Anomaly Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of congenital anterior segment ocular malformations such as iris hypoplasia, corectopia, or anterior synechiae
Identification of systemic extraocular features including craniofacial dysmorphism, skeletal anomalies, or neurological abnormalities
Detection of pathogenic variants in genes known to cause anterior segment developmental anomalies with systemic involvement
Exclusion of other isolated anterior segment dysgenesis syndromes without systemic features

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital anterior segment malformations plus at least one extraocular systemic manifestation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is supportive but not mandatory; clinical diagnosis relies on combined ocular and systemic features.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Anterior synechiae (adhesions of the iris to the cornea)

common.symptomName: Craniofacial dysmorphism including hypertelorism and broad nasal bridge
Skeletal anomalies such as clinodactyly or joint contractures

occasional.symptomName: Glaucoma secondary to anterior segment malformation
searchTerms: eye pressure from eye structure defect
glaucoma due to eye development problem
holes or defects in heart walls

laboratory: Genetic testing identifying mutations in genes such as FOXC1, PITX2, or PAX6
imaging: Anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT) showing iris and angle abnormalities
genetic: Pathogenic variants in developmental genes associated with anterior segment dysgenesis syndromes
other: Slit-lamp examination revealing characteristic anterior segment malformations

distinguishingFeatures: Central corneal opacity with iridocorneal adhesions without systemic extraocular manifestations
Anterior segment dysgenesis with dental and umbilical anomalies but variable systemic involvement

redFlags: Rapidly progressive glaucoma leading to vision loss
Severe developmental delay or neurological deterioration
Congenital heart defects causing hemodynamic instability
references: Orphanet: Anterior Segment Developmental Anomaly with Extraocular Manifestations, ORPHA:519276
